rule: Targets are assigned, not bid. The three seats owe 3, 2 and 5 tricks; making your number or more counts. Taking extra scores nothing -- the surplus becomes the right to take that many of an opponent's best cards next round.
trumpUndecided: Trump: undeclared (the 5-target seat chooses from its first {{seen}} cards)
exchangeLine: {{n}} cards moved for last round's shortfall.
promptTrump: Declare trump -- you can see only {{seen}} of your cards.
hintReasonSelectTrump: your longest suit is the safest call
hintReasonWinTrick: you are short of your target -- go for it
hintReasonDuck: you have made your target -- take no more
